preconditions.expression: 0 <= a and isinstance(a, int) and 1 <= b and isinstance(b, int) and 0 <= k and isinstance(k, int) and k <= a + b and a + b <= 200000
preconditions.description: Input integers a, b, k satisfy 0 ≤ a, 1 ≤ b, 0 ≤ k ≤ a + b ≤ 200000

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout.startswith('Yes') and len(stdout.split()) == 3 and all(len(x) == a + b and x.count('0') == a and x.count('1') == b for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If possible, output 'Yes' followed by two binary strings x and y (x ≥ y) with exactly a zeroes and b ones each, and x - y (in binary) has exactly k ones; otherwise output 'No'

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('Yes') == (any((bin(x).count('1') == k) for x in [int(stdout.split()[1], 2) - int(stdout.split()[2], 2)]))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the binary difference x - y must have exactly k ones in its binary representation
